sections.A: Osteoporosis mein haddi ka mass kam aur andar ki banawat kamzor ho jati hai, is liye halki chot ya girne se fracture ho jata hai.
sections.B: Aksar fracture tak khamosh. Nishaniyan: qad kam hona, kamar ka jhukna aur halki activity par achanak kamar dard.
sections.C: Pehle halki chot se fracture, qad ka kam hona, steroids, girna, DXA ki report aur dawayein.
sections.D: Qad napna (pehle se compare), deewar se sar ka faasla, pasliyon aur pelvis ka faasla, aur balance.
sections.G: Halki activity par achanak shadeed kamar dard (vertebral fracture), ya girne ke baad hip dard aur wazan na uthana: refer.
sections.H: Doctor ke zariye fracture risk (FRAX), haal ka dard wala fracture ho to pehle dard control, phir mehfooz exercise.
sections.I: Progressive resistance training (seedhi kamar ke saath squat, step-ups), impact jahan mehfooz ho, balance aur posture ki exercise.
sections.K: Taaza vertebral fracture mein kuch logon ko brace se aaraam; dawa ka ilaaj doctor ka faisla.
sections.M: Taaqat, balance, posture, dard, hosla aur girna dobara dekhein.
sections.N: Sawaal hal karein. T-score -2.5 ya kam osteoporosis hai; high-risk logon ko kamar mod kar ghumane aur bojh uthane se bachna chahiye.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
